implementation.note: The operations below remain the full proposal. The public header and integration guide define the smaller implemented API; untested capabilities are not claimed.

purpose: In-process AppKit terminal view in a distinct macOS application, rendering a child PTY byte stream with the zterm2 engine.

instance.identifier: UUID allocated by component; included in every event
instance.restart: Create a new instance; never restart implicitly after exit code 75.
instance.eventOrdering: Monotonic sequence per instance, delivered on main thread. Exactly one process-termination event for each successfully launched process; exactly one closed event after teardown.
instance.teardown: Idempotent and asynchronous; closed means child reaped, owned descriptors closed, I/O callbacks drained and submitted GPU work completed. A timeout is reported without pretending teardown succeeded.

input.executable: Absolute executable path, no implicit shell
input.arguments: Array of literal strings, excludes argv[0]
input.environment: Explicit map, no implicit login-shell PATH or secrets in diagnostics
input.workingDirectory: Absolute existing directory, independent of host process cwd

launch.result: Asynchronous started(instanceID, childPID) or launchFailed(instanceID, error); started is not an exec-success proof unless launcher has acknowledged exec.

sendInput.input: Terminal bytes; bounded pending-byte budget and backpressure
sendInput.keyboard: AppKit text input and terminal key mapping, including Option and IME
sendInput.paste: Distinct paste operation follows negotiated bracketed-paste mode; never interpreted as a business command

resize.result: Effective columns, rows, pixel width and pixel height; correlated sizeChanged event after applying TIOCSWINSZ
resize.rules: Positive finite dimensions; clamp to supported cell and pixel limits, coalesce stale pending sizes, derive cells from actual font metrics and margins. Never treat points as Retina pixels.

requestStop.input: Instance-owned child/process group only; grace deadline then explicit escalation policy
requestStop.result: termination event with requested=true and actual raw wait status
requestStop.prohibition: Never stop Vigil, OpenCode, another terminal or a shared engine.

close.input: No arguments; safe in created, starting, running, exited or failed states
close.result: One closed event after the teardown barrier; repeated calls observe the same completion. No callbacks after closed.

attachPTY.rule: Reject with unsupportedOperation before taking descriptor ownership. No ambiguous borrowed descriptor or child-reaping semantics.

ownership.host: Owns controller and adds its view to the native hierarchy; retains through close completion. SwiftUI makeNSView creates once, updateNSView only updates layout, dismantleNSView requests close.
ownership.component: Owns terminal engine, child PTY, master descriptor, child-reaping authority, I/O queues, parser work, timers, observers, renderer and resources. Does not own NSApplication, the host window or business services.
ownership.mainThread: Creation, view hierarchy, keyboard, size requests, state transitions and all public callbacks. AppKit main runloop must run until close completes; never synchronously join worker or GPU work on it.
ownership.workerThreads: Bounded I/O/parser work; callbacks marshal to the instance main-thread event stream. Cancellation drains work already accepted before releasing state.
ownership.gpu: A submitted command retains every resource it references until completion. No slot reuse or resource destruction merely because close was requested.
ownership.isolation: Explicit component bundle, preferences and storage roots, no updater registration, standard iTerm2 preferences import, production services, login item, credential migration, global signal handler or host-child reaping. Two instances share immutable resources only.

capabilities.declaration: Metadata is not a positive path probe. Each capability reports unsupported, declared-unprobed or probed with evidence and instance identity.
currentImplementedComponentCapabilities: in-process AppKit view with CPU rendering
explicit child PTY launch and environment
native keyboard, focus, bracketed UTF-8 paste and SGR mouse
cell and pixel resizing at measured backing scale
actual raw wait status and asynchronous teardown
capabilities.experimentalImageGPU: Separate opt-in qualification after baseline M1; do not infer any Cardo improvement from image microbenchmarks.
capabilities.businessCommands: Not provided by terminal. Cardo owns a structured, instance-correlated channel separate from PTY bytes.

packagingGate: Compile and link a distinct native host against the versioned component
Enumerate exact runtime frameworks, libraries, resources, shaders, helpers, entitlements and licenses for the actual artifact
Positive fixture rendering and interaction evidence on the developer-designated VM
Verify normal exit, code 75, requested stop, close during activity, two instances and repeated teardown
Measure child, descriptor and GPU retention after teardown; separate fixture-only tests from component/UI results
Corresponding sources, reproducible build command, immutable artifact and SHA-256 manifest
